outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of the sliding sign for predicting intra-abdominal adhesions
cohort: 63 pregnant women with a history of at least one Cesarean delivery
finding: The 'sliding sign' of the uterus on ultrasound, which assesses the sliding of the uterus under the fascia of the abdominal muscles during deep breathing, was found to be a potential predictor of intra-abdominal adhesions in women undergoing repeat Cesarean section, with a sensitivity of 76.2% and a specificity of 92.1%.
